canonical_project: AirTrunk Raigad Pen Growth Centre campus
notes: Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis announced on 1 Jun 2026 that a Letter of Intent for land allotment was exchanged with AirTrunk CEO Robin Khuda at the Raigad Pen Growth Centre (Orange City); ~Rs 2 lakh crore (~US$21-24bn) investment, planned 3 GW capacity; part of AirTrunk's US$30bn / 5 GW India commitment (entered India via Lumina CloudInfra acquisition, Apr 2026).
